name: Higure Anghel
source:
A quirky [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luzon_Bleeding-heart]Luzon Bleeding-heart[/URL] dove that is a member of the school's manga club. Anghel is in the homeroom next to Hiyoko's (2nd Year, Class 2). He is a weird loner that speaks and refers to people as though he were in a video game. Anghel believes that he is an angel with a "mission", and that a destructive force is sealed within his chest.

NOTE: He does not appear in the demo version of Heartful Boyfriend.

[Based on the [URL=http://clione.halfmoon.jp/hatoful-boyfriend/character/angel.html]official website[/URL].]
